description: Chinese small-scale VAT taxpayer 2026: threshold (起征点) 100,000 CNY per month or 300,000 CNY per quarter until 2027-12-31 - below it VAT is exempt, at or above it the whole amount is taxed (VAT Law art. 23, MOF/STA 2026 No. 10); 3% levy rate reduced to 1% except selling or leasing real estate and land use rights; above 5 million CNY a year the taxpayer is no longer small-scale (VAT Law art. 9). Mainland China, as of 2026-11-21 (laws and State Taxation Administration announcements in the official regulations database). General information and estimates only; no individual tax consulting, agency or filing. The 2027 filing calendar is not yet published.
